dictionary.title: Agents
dictionary.description: Every {assistant} feature is an agent: priority, instructions, settings, tools and widgets under your control.
dictionary.autonomy: {assistant} can create agents, tools and widgets on her own
dictionary.autonomy_hint: When needed, the Forge combines existing tools into new ones and creates widgets and agents. Every creation shows up in the log below.
dictionary.priority_hint: The higher it is, the more this agent wins when agents compete for the same resource (e.g. speakers, screen).
dictionary.instructions_placeholder: E.g.: after 10 pm always use low volume; only alert me for urgent things.
dictionary.instructions_hint: Instructions are given to the brain every time this agent works or is involved by the team.
dictionary.task_label: Assign a task or leave a message ({count} waiting)
dictionary.task_placeholder: Write the task for this agent
dictionary.delete_agent_body: The agent is removed from the team; its tools and widgets go back to their default agents.
dictionary.settings_empty: This agent has no editable settings.
dictionary.people_only: Visible only when one of these people is present
dictionary.name: Name
dictionary.tool_hint: A new tool is a sequence of existing tools. In the arguments use {{parameter}} for parameters and {{s1}}, {{s2}}… for the results of previous steps. Step confirmations are inherited.
dictionary.widget_hint: The widget starts with a standard look (title, value, text, list); agents fill it with the show_widget tool.
dictionary.personal_data: Contains personal data (closes when nobody is around)
